text:
(The Bride’s Ballad Book)


The three sisters were there,
the three from every tale,
the three up on the balcony
weaving lace and dreams.


I walked down the street
and looked up… My dry footsteps
echoed, forgotten,
in the evening silence.


The eldest looked, curious,
and the middle one, laughing,
looked at me and said something to you…
You embroidered in silence


as though you did not care,
as though it frightened you.
Then you stood up
and told me a secret

in one long gaze,
long, long… The reflections
in the blurred windowpanes
erased the outline of your slender


profile. Your figure was
the flower in a halo of dream.
…Three you were, three sisters,
as in the storybooks.

translation.title: The Three Sisters Were There...
